capabilities: Look up food nutrition across Boohee, USDA FoodData Central, Chinese food composition data, and local datasets
Calculate meal nutrition from ingredient names and gram weights
Compare 30+ nutrients against DRI reference groups
Insert food details, meal summaries, and DRI tables as Markdown into notes
Rematch ingredients or switch data sources during meal calculation
extras: Docs are bilingual (English and Chinese). The README warns results are for recording and reference analysis and should not replace professional nutrition or medical advice; a small built-in dataset is used as fallback when no external databases are configured.
intentEvidence: 相比单纯的薄荷健康查询工具，本插件更适合用于餐品研发、膳食记录、营养核算
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query nutrition databases, compute meal totals from ingredient lists, or insert nutrition and DRI tables into notes.

relations.evidence: Multi-source nutrition lookup from Boohee, Boohee restaurant foods, USDA FoodData Central
combines Boohee, USDA FoodData Central, Chinese food composition data, and local nutrition datasets
Optional OpenAI-compatible AI mapping for nutrient field normalization and Chinese ingredient name standardization

requires.name: Boohee open platform App ID and App Key
OpenAI-compatible API key for AI nutrient mapping

summary: Nutrition analysis plugin that looks up foods across Boohee, USDA FoodData Central and Chinese food databases, calculates meal nutrition, and compares 30+ DRIs.
